Who is Aldo Gordini?

Aldo Gordini (born 20 May 1921 and died 28 January 1995) was an Italian-born French racing driver. He was the son of Amédée Gordini, the owner of the French sports car manufacturer . He participated in the 1951 French Grand Prix driving a , although his car's engine did not manage to complete the race distance.
